notes: P5: NavRail (10b-spec). Closed = the passive 44 dp strip; open = the 288 dp panel (strip alpha 1->0, panel -288->0 over 280 ms).
Opened by LEFT on the hero's Play (10d §4: left on button 0 -> requestRailOpen). Focus lands on the active section's item (Home, index 1).
Items in order: 0 search (icon only), 1 home, 2 movies, 3 shows, 4 list, 5 ai, [spacer], 6 settings, 7 profile pill.

UP at item 0 wraps to the profile pill unless focusJustMoved(120): the states reach each item with DOWN steps 150 ms apart (keyGapMs) so no wrap is triggered, except 'item-profile-wrap' which tests the wrap after a pause.
RailHues loops hold phase 0.37 under freeze.
2026-10-10: `freeze on,mid` holds the slide at 0.5 (panel half out at -144 dp, strip alpha 0.5, second body and hues at alpha 0.5) for a still capture of the slide's middle.
Close paths: RIGHT and BACK slide out (280 ms) and hand focus back; OK on an item closes at once (instantClose) and navigates.
